preparation_checklist: Select research papers absent from every existing corpus, calibration run and development experiment.
Assign each paper and its translations entirely to dev or holdout.
Verify licenses and record paper source URL, exact bytes SHA256 and all page numbers.
Author fact, numeric, list, comparison and limitation cases with answerable, unsupported and false-premise cases in each split.
Record gold pages and reference claims without exposing them to retrieval or generation.
Freeze the rubric and source hashes before evaluation. Tune settings using dev only.
Have a named or pseudonymous reviewer label factual correctness, completeness and citation support. Record whether this reviewer is independent.
Run the complete pipeline once on holdout and publish failures, raw outputs, runtime identity and exact code revision.
